name: Sgt. "Chapman"
summary: A sergeant Larry named in an August 2026 phone call — "Chapman, or something like that." The comment came up around the basic-training part of the conversation, so the working hypothesis is a sergeant from his 1963–64 basic training, but the context was not captured. He is understood to be a separate man from Sgt. Lowry/Lowery, not a correction of that name.
larrysRecollection: Larry recalled a sergeant whose name he believed was Chapman, "or something like that."

Confirm with Larry who Chapman was — basic-training cadre, unit sergeant, or someone else — and where basic training took place.
